run_pose_training_with_visualization: run the pose model training script with visualization of keypoints on training dataset images
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to get CLI options for pose model training and visualization
run_merge_args: run the merge function to combine CLI arguments with the training config file
run_visualize_keypoints: run the main function to visualize keypoints on random samples from the training dataset
run_visualizer_draw_kpts: run the visualizer to draw instance keypoints on RGB images and save as BGR JPEG
